title: Team of the Tournament — fixed for good this time
items: Defenders and keepers were meant to stay hidden until Matchday has a real lineup data source, but stale entries left over from before ESPN lineups were removed kept silently reappearing anyway — a fix from July 20 addressed the symptom, not the cause. Now structurally gated off regardless of what the old data file contains, verified live against the actual stale file.
